title: DNS over HTTPS in DNS Control

prose.text: {{doh-covered}} Whether a DoH query is matched without SSL inspection of the DoH provider is open {{gap:doh-needs-decryption}}. SSL inspection coverage of a destination is in [[zia.ssl-inspection.pipeline]].
{{doh-protocol-value}} {{doh-protocol-choice}} The console's Redirect Request Using DoH action is in [[zia.dns-control.actions]].

checks.do: Whether the DoH provider's domain is inside an SSL inspection rule, before saying DoH traffic is inspected.
Whether the tenant's DNS rules have a protocols value of DOHTTPS_RULE.
Whether a Redirect Request Using DoH action is read as applying to DoH traffic, since the options narrow with the action.

doh-covered.statement: Zscaler states DNS Control monitors and applies policy to all DNS requests and responses irrespective of protocol and encryption, including UDP, TCP and DNS over HTTPS.

quotes: Monitor and apply policies to all DNS requests and responses, irrespective of the protocol and the encryption used. This includes UDP, TCP, and DNS over HTTPS (DoH).

doh-protocol-value.statement: The rule `protocols` field has a DNS-over-HTTPS value `DOHTTPS_RULE`, alongside `ANY_RULE`, `SMRULEF_CASCADING_ALLOWED`, `TCP_RULE` and `UDP_RULE`.

doh-protocol-choice.statement: A rule's Protocols condition offers DNS Over HTTPS, TCP and UDP; the options shown narrow with the chosen action (for example, only DoH and TCP for Redirect Request Using TCP).

quotes: Select the protocols you want to control from DNS Over HTTPS, TCP, and UDP.
The protocols displayed might vary with the Action selected for the rule.
For example, only DNS Over HTTPS and TCP are shown for the Redirect Request Using TCP action

doh-needs-decryption.title: Whether DoH queries are matched by DNS Control without SSL inspection of the DoH provider
doh-needs-decryption.blocks: saying whether a DoH-blocking DNS rule works for uninspected DoH providers
doh-needs-decryption.detail: Unverified legacy statement: "For ZIA to inspect the DNS payload and apply DNS Control rules to it, SSL Inspection must be enabled for the DoH provider's domain (e.g., cloudflare-dns.com, dns.google). Without decryption, ZIA sees an HTTPS flow to a DoH endpoint; DNS Control doesn't engage on the inner DNS query." Also: the operator can combine SSL Inspection with DNS Control, or block DoH providers at URL Filtering or Firewall Filtering; without decryption the operator cannot match query name, record type or response inside DoH; the help statement is 'contingent on' SSL Inspection. The help pages say DoH is covered 'irrespective of the protocol and the encryption used' and do not mention a dependency. Test a DoH query to a provider outside any SSL inspection rule against a DNS rule scoped to DoH and read the log. Also: operators who enable DoH-blocking via DNS Control without SSL Inspection covering DoH endpoints "get false confidence; DoH flows to uninspected providers are opaque."
